verdict.rationale: Jan documents model downloading/importing (Hub search, GGUF import), assistants with custom personas/instructions assigned per-project, and a settings/API server config, covering models, prompts, and configs in one app. However, there's no evidence of a unified management view combining all three, and no independent hands-on confirmation of usability. missing for 10: dedicated unified dashboard evidence for models+prompts+configs together, independent/community corroboration of this workflow.
